_meta.purpose: MISC Starlancer MAX ship + zone definitions.
_meta.axis_convention: Width = port-to-starboard (X). Length = ramp-end to forward (Y). Height = floor up (Z). All units are 1.25 m cubes.
_meta.ramp_note: The Starlancer MAX loads via the rear; both bays use ramp_side='low_y' with ship_forward_y='high' so the rear/entry end renders at the bottom of the diagram.
_meta.layout_note: Forward bay = the upper pad bay: two columns F1/F2, each 16+24+24 = 64 SCU. Rear bay = the lower vehicle-bay section: side pad stacks R1/R2 ((4+16+4) x2 = 48 SCU each) flanking the central Rear Bulk zone RB.
_meta.rb_note: RB (Rear Bulk) is the vehicle-bay floor. It is rated conservatively at 32 SCU and given the HIGHEST unload_priority so the planner only fills it as a last-ditch overflow zone, after F1/F2/R1/R2. Its width/length/height describe the physical bay box; scu_capacity (32) is the rated bulk limit and is intentionally lower than the box volume.
_meta.totals: Ship total = F1 64 + F2 64 + R1 48 + R2 48 + RB 32 = 256 SCU. Pad grid alone (per the in-game layout image) is 224 SCU.

zones.notes: Forward pad bay, port column (16 + 24 + 24 SCU pads).
Forward pad bay, starboard column (16 + 24 + 24 SCU pads).
Rear bay, port pad stack ((4 + 16 + 4) x2 SCU pads).
Rear Bulk — vehicle-bay floor used for bulk cargo. Highest unload_priority so the planner treats it as a last-ditch overflow zone.
Rear bay, starboard pad stack ((4 + 16 + 4) x2 SCU pads).
